(a) encoding of time intervals activates the basal ganglia and the right inferior pariental and premotor cortices; (b) comparing time intervals activates the right dorsolatral prefrontal cortex; and (c) implementing a response activates the right dorsomedial prefrontal cortex.

the brain activation associated with temporal processing is dynamic and depends on the task component being performed.
